coach.description: Ask a question about your training. An AI model answers from your workouts of the last 30 days.
coach.privacy: When you ask a question, your question and a summary of your workouts of the last 30 days are sent to Mistral AI to generate the answer: session dates and durations, exercises with sets, repetitions and top weights, weekly session counts, total volume, and estimated one-rep maxes. Your name, e-mail address and workout notes are never sent. Athlya does not store the question or the answer.
